flags.why: The noun sense meaning a model to follow is dated, as recorded in [Wiktionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/gương_mẫu), but has no currency tag.

The knot sense is regional to Central and Southern Vietnamese, as recorded in the [Huế dialect dictionary](https://khungcuahep.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/Từ-Điển-Phương-Ngữ-Huế-Trần-Ngọc-Bảo.pdf), but lacks region tags.
flags.fix: Add the tags Central and Southern.
